publication.title: Twenty-nine years of continuous monthly capture-mark-recapture data of multimammate mice (Mastomys natalensis) in Morogoro, Tanzania
publication.protocol: one 3-ha 300-station grid, 30 x 10, 10 m lattice, every month for 3 consecutive nights

reason: NEON future Peromyscus has only ~6% of developmental adjusted MNKA sum-of-squares information, so an event-heldout negative sign does not precisely exclude the old positive slope. MOSA has extensive repeated *within-plot* density episodes, potentially offering a more informative one-species external ecological test.

non_equivalence.what_can_test: Within-species 29-year density-associated reallocation of spatial variance between repeated within-animal trap positions and between-animal trap-centroid spread.
non_equivalence.what_cannot_test: The original frozen NEON 8-genus or 5-genus generality claims, standardized numerical equality of m²/MNKA slopes across radically different grid geometries, or causal territoriality.

no_effect_exposure_before_structural_gat.validate_download: Zenodo official API, published file size and cryptographic checksum, forbid challenge HTML
no_effect_exposure_before_structural_gat.forbidden_if_fail: Lower support threshold or merge non-consecutive months to fabricate a three-night within-bout W response
no_effect_exposure_before_structural_gat.allowed_if_pass: A newly specified one-species, one-plot time-series association, still prospective only relative to MOSA response outcomes; results explicitly treated as post-NEON-generated hypothesis.

observation_process.reference_scale: within-MOSA comparisons only; cannot directly transport unnormalized variance magnitudes from 10x10 NEON
observation_process.individual_sampling_selection: report m and unique captured cohort count with abundance proxy
observation_process.site_temporal_dependence: report effective temporal replication and autocorrelation rather than treating 300 traps as 300 independent populations
